Sam (Eng-API): quick heads-up: I'm leaning proto-first for new internal surfaces. benefits: codegen, smaller wire, explicit schemas. downside: we need a clear plan for gateway->json transpilation and keeping telemetry intact. any pushback?
Priya (Platform): +1 to proto-first from contract safety. we tried gateway translation in a spike and discovered route attributes were lost in some edge-cases (multi-tenant headers getting rewritten). had to add explicit pass-through rules.
Diego (Eng-Platform): gateway aggregation is the main pain. if the gateway normalizes multiple RPC methods into one JSON endpoint we lose per-method metrics. that's bad for canaries/rollouts.
Asha (DevEx): from DX standpoint, proto-first dramatically improves SDK ergonomics. but customers expect the console to show per-method latency/cost. if we show only gateway-level metrics during rollouts, PMs get the wrong signal.
Ravi (SRE): workaround we used elsewhere: add a compact telemetry header that the gateway sets and backends consume. keep it binary/compact to avoid header bloat. must include version, route, and sampling id.
Sam (Eng-API): concrete idea: gateway emits header `X-RW-TEL-B64` which contains a base64-encoded proto: {version:int, service:string, method:string, orig_path:string, sample_id:bytes}. backend libs can decode and tag metrics accordingly.
Priya (Platform): gateway should still emit gateway-level metrics. backends emit service/method metrics when they see the header. console can then display both. need a rollout plan for services that don't handle the header yet.
Diego (Eng-Platform): alternative: keep translation minimal and route full proto via 1:1 passthrough to services, only translate for browser clients with a dedicated JSON facade. that reduces telemetry distortion but increases client-side surface APIs.
Asha (DevEx): console UX ask: add a toggle "Edge vs Backend view" and annotate charts when we're in mixed-mode during migration (so users know some metrics are incomplete). also surface an index of services that have "tel-headers enabled".
Ravi (SRE): operational constraints: header size limit ~8KB on our infra, but we should target <1KB. parsing cost matters under heavy QPS. propose we cap sample_id to 8 bytes and short service/method names.
Sam (Eng-API): agreed on constraints. action items: Sam/Diego will draft the telemetry envelope proto and B64 header spec; Ravi will provide limits and perf guidance; Priya will write migration checklist for gateway rules; Asha will mock console toggle and service index.
deploy-bot: rolling canary of gateway-telemetry-envelope to prod-us-west at 2025-03-11T09:12:00Z :rocket:
Priya (Platform): noted. watch `gateway.telemetry.envelope.missing` and `gateway.telemetry.invalid` metrics during canary. we'll convene a quick sync in #eng-platform tomorrow 10am PT to review the draft.
Sam (Eng-API): thanks everyone. I'll drop the RFC link here once the draft is ready.
